Hi, 

Thanks for the confirmation.

I forgot to mention:

#### Workaround

On MySQL 8, instead of SUPER, use ALL PRIVILEGES. Example:

GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES On *.* TO vgrippa@'%';
`GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.*` is not an acceptable workaround for many use-cases because of the security vulnerabilities it would introduce. This bug is still present in 8.0.40
